messages:
Jamie: FYI planning a phased-burst canary for model v7.2 tomorrow 09:00 PST. Goal: percent + regional ramp with a short burst window for traffic shaping. Need sign-off on guardrails, alerts, and rollback hooks. Ping @Priya @Alonzo @Maria. Proposed config below.

Jamie: ```
flag: model_v7_phased_burst
enabled: true
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
    duration_min: 30
  - pct: 5
    regions: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
    duration_min: 60
burst:
  enabled: true
  window_pct: 10
  cooldown_min: 15
alerts:
  p99_latency_ms: 500
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
```

Priya: Quick question — do we have an automated rollback on alert burn-rate or is this manual? Also we should gate on quality evals (BLEU/ROUGE-ish for our eval prompts).

Alonzo: I'll own smoke tests. After stage 1 I'll run the smoke suite against the canary. PR for the deployment wiring: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/1245

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Toggle staged applied to canary-config at 2141598800 by @Jamie :white_check_mark:

Kate (oncall): I'll set up pager rules: page if error_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m or p99 > 600ms. Adding a runbook entry and an ephemeral channel for the rollout.

Maria: I'll add a temporary dashboard: model/v7.2/canary with token-level cost, p50/p95/p99, error rate, and sampled traces. Also enable log-sampler tag `canary=true`. We should sample 1% of outputs for hallucination eval.

Jamie: Proposed roll schedule: 09:00 flip to stage 1 (1% us-east), wait 30m observe metrics + smoke tests, then 09:45 -> stage 2 (5% us-east + us-west-2) for 60m with optional 10% burst windows on low-latency periods. Any objections?

Alonzo: No objections. I'll be online for stage 1 and stage 2. If I see regressions I can abort and revert PR.

Priya: +1. Also recommend pre-warming KV cache: replay ~500 recent requests tagged for this model 15m before flip to minimize p99 spikes.

Jamie: Good call — scheduling a replay job at 08:45. I'll update INF ticket INF-334 with timeline and runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary traffic increased 1% -> 5% at 2141599000. Observed so far: error_rate 0.10%, p99 latency 210ms.

Maria: Sampling logs look clean so far. No obvious behavioral regressions in the eval set.

Kate (oncall): Watching alerts, thresholds set. I'll escalate to SRE if we hit the page conditions.

Jamie: If anything abnormal, abort with: `/flag set model_v7_phased_burst.enabled false --scope canary` or ping this channel and I'll flip. Thanks team — will post a short postmortem if any action required after rollout. :thumbsup:
